integrity: Exact proof uses the Rayleigh principle, an equality-rigidity argument, and a four-orbit spectral decomposition. Standard-library rational checks replay finitely many cases but are not substituted for the universal proof. Related tree, discrete-time, and resistance results are distinguished by objective and domain.
scientific_limitations: The exact optimum outside the factor-two size range is not evaluated; nonuniform edge costs, strictly positive requirements on all allowed edges, and multiple bridges are outside the theorem.
title: Sharp factor-two sparsification boundary for budgeted mixing across a single bridge
